meta.title: Order Desk
meta.description: A staff-facing order fulfillment queue for WooCommerce: see what needs packing, open an order for its items and shipping address, and mark it completed in one tap.
meta.author: Alex Kirk

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! function_exists( 'wc_get_products' ) || ! class_exists( 'WC_Order' ) ) {
	return;
}

$product_ids = wc_get_products(
	array(
		'limit'  => 20,
		'status' => 'publish',
		'return' => 'ids',
	)
);

if ( empty( $product_ids ) ) {
	return;
}

$customers = array(
	array(
		'first'    => 'Jamie',
		'last'     => 'Nolan',
		'email'    => 'jamie.nolan@example.com',
		'address'  => '145 Alder St',
		'city'     => 'Portland',
		'state'    => 'OR',
		'postcode' => '97201',
		'country'  => 'US',
	),
	array(
		'first'    => 'Priya',
		'last'     => 'Desai',
		'email'    => 'priya.desai@example.com',
		'address'  => '900 Congress Ave',
		'city'     => 'Austin',
		'state'    => 'TX',
		'postcode' => '78701',
		'country'  => 'US',
	),
	array(
		'first'    => 'Marco',
		'last'     => 'Silva',
		'email'    => 'marco.silva@example.com',
		'address'  => '55 16th St',
		'city'     => 'Denver',
		'state'    => 'CO',
		'postcode' => '80202',
		'country'  => 'US',
	),
	array(
		'first'    => 'Rina',
		'last'     => 'Kobayashi',
		'email'    => 'rina.kobayashi@example.com',
		'address'  => '210 Pike St',
		'city'     => 'Seattle',
		'state'    => 'WA',
		'postcode' => '98101',
		'country'  => 'US',
	),
	array(
		'first'    => 'Deshawn',

		'address'  => '80 Peachtree St',
		'city'     => 'Atlanta',
		'state'    => 'GA',
		'postcode' => '30303',
		'country'  => 'US',
	),
	array(

		'address'  => '12 Nicollet Mall',
		'city'     => 'Minneapolis',
		'state'    => 'MN',

		'country'  => 'US',
	),
	array(
		'first'    => 'Oscar',
		'last'     => 'Reyes',
		'email'    => 'oscar.reyes@example.com',
		'address'  => '300 W Washington St',
		'city'     => 'Phoenix',
		'state'    => 'AZ',
		'postcode' => '85003',
		'country'  => 'US',
	),
	array(
		'first'    => 'Nadia',
		'last'     => 'Petrov',
		'email'    => 'nadia.petrov@example.com',
		'address'  => '1 E Wacker Dr',
		'city'     => 'Chicago',
		'state'    => 'IL',
		'postcode' => '60601',
		'country'  => 'US',
	),
);

// Skew toward "processing" so the fulfillment queue isn't empty on first load.
$statuses = array( 'processing', 'processing', 'processing', 'processing', 'processing', 'on-hold', 'completed', 'completed' );

foreach ( $customers as $index => $customer ) {
	$order = new WC_Order();
	$order->save();

	foreach ( array( 'billing', 'shipping' ) as $type ) {
		$order->{"set_{$type}_first_name"}( $customer['first'] );
		$order->{"set_{$type}_last_name"}( $customer['last'] );
		$order->{"set_{$type}_address_1"}( $customer['address'] );
		$order->{"set_{$type}_city"}( $customer['city'] );
		$order->{"set_{$type}_state"}( $customer['state'] );
		$order->{"set_{$type}_postcode"}( $customer['postcode'] );
		$order->{"set_{$type}_country"}( $customer['country'] );
	}
	$order->set_billing_email( $customer['email'] );

	$count  = min( wp_rand( 1, 3 ), count( $product_ids ) );
	$picked = (array) array_rand( array_flip( $product_ids ), $count );

	foreach ( $picked as $product_id ) {
		$product = wc_get_product( $product_id );
		if ( $product ) {
			$order->add_product( $product, wp_rand( 1, 2 ) );
		}
	}

	$order->calculate_totals();
	$order->set_status( $statuses[ $index % count( $statuses ) ] );
	$order->save();
}
